1.explanation: We import a minimal DataTable and place a `<TableToolbarSearch aria-label="Custom search label" />` inside the toolbar. When you run this code and inspect the resulting `<div role="search">` in the browser devtools, you will see that it lacks the `aria-label` attribute even though it was passed in as a prop. This reproduces the bug in `TableToolbarSearch.js` where the wrapper never applies the passed-in aria-label to the DOM.
1.bug_scenario: In the DataTable "With toolbar" story, when you add an `aria-label` prop to the `<TableToolbarSearch>` component (for example `<TableToolbarSearch aria-label="My custom search label" onChange={...} />`), the rendered `<div role="search">` container does _not_ receive the `aria-label` attribute in the DOM. You can verify this in your browser’s devtools: the search container has `role="search"` but no `aria-label` value, making the region inaccessible.
